faq.question: Which plan sizes do you print?
faq.reponse: From A3 to A0: A0 (841 x 1189 mm), A1 (594 x 841 mm), A2 (420 x 594 mm) and A3 (297 x 420 mm), in black and white or colour.

faq.question: Which file should I send?
faq.reponse: A PDF exported at scale, at the exact sheet size, from AutoCAD, ArchiCAD, Revit or SketchUp. Send it on WhatsApp at 0773 58 99 54 or bring a USB stick.

faq.question: Can you fold my plans to A4?
faq.reponse: Yes, we fold plans to A4 with the title block visible, ready for filing. We can also deliver them rolled.

faq.question: Do you print architecture competition files?
faq.reponse: Yes: boards, written documents, folding and binding, following the format required by the competition brief.

faq.question: Do you work with architecture students?
faq.reponse: Yes. We print project and final-year boards and sell tracing paper, foam board and model-making supplies.

faq.question: Do you scan plans?
faq.reponse: Yes, we scan large format plans for archiving or editing.
